# Deepak Rathore

> Personal portfolio of Deepak Rathore, a senior full-stack software engineer with 6 years of experience building web applications and APIs in Go, Node.js, TypeScript, React/Next.js, and PostgreSQL.

The canonical website is https://www.deepakrathore.online/. It is a single-page portfolio; the links below identify sections of that page, not separate pages.

Deepak's work includes commerce, returns, logistics, and supply-chain software, Shopify Admin GraphQL API integrations, and webhooks. The portfolio includes professional case studies, open-source contributions, work experience, skills, and contact information.

## Portfolio

- [About](https://www.deepakrathore.online/#about): Background and engineering experience.
- [Featured work](https://www.deepakrathore.online/#featured): Case studies covering manual returns, explainable return-risk scoring, carrier-aware delivery management, Roslyn contributions, and retailer and nonprofit dashboards.
- [Experience](https://www.deepakrathore.online/#experience): Professional roles and responsibilities.
- [Skills](https://www.deepakrathore.online/#skills): Languages, frontend, backend, databases, cloud platforms, and development tools.
- [Open-source projects](https://www.deepakrathore.online/#work): Lua-GL and LuaRocks Google Summer of Code projects.
- [Contact](https://www.deepakrathore.online/#contact): Email and professional profiles.
